title: Payroll System
shortDesc: Admin system for reports, accounts, and salary management.
longDesc:
Admin system for reports, accounts, and salary management. Built with C# and SQL.

Features:
• Employee database management
• Salary computation with deductions
• Generate payslips (PDF)
• Attendance and leave tracking
• Role-based access for HR and employees
• Comprehensive reports (monthly, yearly)
• Tax computation support
